standard_prerequisites.name: Sheaf on a basis: the sheaf condition and its uniqueness part stated for coverings and pairwise intersections by basis elements (definition-sheaf-basis)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides both the injectivity of F(U) into the product of stalks and the gluing of the sigma_i.

core_obligations: Injectivity: two sections of F(U) with the same germs at every point of U agree on a basis covering of U, so they are equal by the uniqueness part of the sheaf condition on a basis (proof lines 4127-4129). Surjectivity onto property-(*) families: let (s_x) satisfy (*); the condition provides a covering U = union U_i by basis elements with (s_x) on U_i represented by sections sigma_i in F(U_i) (proof lines 4129-4132). For y in U_i cap U_j the sections sigma_i and sigma_j have the same germ at y, so some basis element V_{ijy} containing y has sigma_i|_{V_{ijy}} = sigma_j|_{V_{ijy}} (proof lines 4132-4135). The sheaf condition on a basis then glues the sigma_i to a section s in F(U) whose germs are the s_x (proof lines 4136-4140).
proof_roadmap: Get injectivity from the uniqueness part of the sheaf condition on a basis (proof lines 4127-4129).
Cover U by basis elements carrying the sigma_i and glue them with the sheaf condition (proof lines 4129-4140).
